editorial:
Imagine a world where cars were brand new and a simple ride could be the ultimate way to impress someone. You get to follow Gaby, a woman caught between two guys who are both trying to win her heart. One guy tries to be cool with a motorcycle, while the other shows off with his fancy car. It feels like a lighthearted rom-com at first, but things quickly turn into a wild competition. The vibe is energetic and a bit chaotic, making you wonder who Gaby will actually pick and how far the losers will go to get their way.

What really grabs you is how the movie shifts from a love story into a crazy chase scene. The pacing is surprisingly quick for an old film, and the action feels genuine. While the silent acting can be a bit over-the-top, it adds to the charm of the era. If you love old-school cinema, you should definitely try renting this on Apple TV or maybe adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best quality. It is a great pick for anyone who enjoys vintage comedies with a mean streak.
endingExplained: After Gaby marries the man with the car, the rejected suitor decides to get even. He tricks the newlyweds into his car and drives like a madman, creating a dangerous high-speed ride. He calls the police to make the situation even more stressful. Eventually, the police catch up to them, and the revenge plot falls apart. The movie ends with the couple safe and the bitter ex finally getting what he deserves for his wild plan.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silent films and early car chases.
